title: The Written Test Between Tat Khalsa and the Gangu Shahis

blocks.text: Outrage nearly becomes bloodshed when the Tat Khalsa party felt outraged and got ready instantly to fight, while Mehar Singh stood blocking their passage so the rival side could not simply flee the challenge.
Elders intervene and persuade both camps to settle the matter without entering into a fight, shifting the dispute from armed confrontation to a test that everyone can witness.

The agreed proof is simple and public: whichever side truly blessed the host with a son will be vindicated, and the terms are fixed through an assurance in black and white so neither faction can retreat later.
